priorityList: Use Trinkets and Potions during Metamorphosis.
Cast Void Ray to maintain the Eradicate buff.
Cast Pierce the Veil if Moment of Craving is active and Collapsing Star is ready.
Cast Voidblade if you have maximum stacks of Void Metamorphosis (requires Devourer's Bite).
Cast The Hunt if you have maximum stacks of Void Metamorphosis (requires Devourer's Bite and Voidsurge).
Cast Metamorphosis on cooldown (or while Eradicate is active).
Execute the Reaps sequence (Eradicate > Cull > Reap) if you have 4+ Souls consumed and Metamorphosis is active.
Execute the Reaps sequence (Eradicate > Cull > Reap) whenever Voidfall spending procs.
Cast Voidblade if Moment of Craving is active and you are at or near max Collapsing Star stacks.
Cast Collapsing Star if Dark Matter is active, Apex is proc'd, or if talented into Star Fragments.
Cast Vengeful Retreat when the Voidstep buff is active.
Cast Reapers Toll if the Voidsurge/Reapers Toll proc is active.
Cast Pierce the Veil as your primary melee strike when talented into Duty Eternal (Single Target) or Devourer's Bite.
Cast Voidblade if Metamorphosis is up and you have Devourer's Bite (but not Voidsurge).
Use Devour and Consume as fillers to generate resources and fragments.
